text:
The 1960 deed left the friend a fee simple subject to a shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25, and that interest is void under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities because church use and a child’s twenty-fifth birthday might occur more than 21 years after every life in being at the conveyance. Striking the void interest leaves the friend with a fee simple absolute, so title is in the friend only.

CONFIDENCE: 92
